habit_scope: Inspection ladder through Certificate of Occupancy on a 2-story light-wood SFR. CMHC Ch2 Fig 2. Punch-list procedure is a Gap (opened Ch2 and Ch29 — Ch29 is maintenance, not punch). No skip-inspection. No stamp.
how_it_is_done: Opened CMHC Ch2 APPROVALS, PERMITS AND INSPECTIONS and Fig 2. Municipalities may not inspect every stage; most will inspect foundations, framing, plumbing and when electrical, insulation and exterior finishes are complete. Schedule inspections to avoid delays. Determine what work must be complete and how much notice is required. Consult the local building department. Confirm AHJ — this list is Canadian NBC, not IRC.

Fig 2 construction-stage inspections named: Excavation and Footings; Pre-Backfill; Framing; Sewers/Drains/Water Service and Underground Plumbing; Electrical Service; Plumbing, Heating and Electrical Rough-In; Insulation and Air/Vapour Barrier; Pre-Occupancy; Final Plumbing, Heating and Electrical; Completion Inspection (Interior and Exterior); Certificate of Occupancy. Warranty-program inspections may add holds in some areas.
No skip-inspection. This Method is the ladder, not a city checklist and not a PE stamp.

Opened CMHC Ch29 Maintenance: service-life upkeep (re-slope fill, etc.). It is NOT a punch/CO chapter. Punch-list procedure (who walks, what form, retainage) is not in Ch2 or Ch29 — see gap-P18-punch-list.
Ch2 closing of Paint/Cabinets/Fixtures: inspected and functioning; instructions and warranties provided; final clean-up.

HUD RSDG OPENED: IRC written so builder + official can inspect without a PE; PE when tables fail — already used on P05/P07/P08, not a punch SOP. FM 5-426 and Essential Guide OPENED: silent on CO/punch.
inspection_hold_points: Do not skip staged inspections (Ch2 Fig 2). No skip-inspection.
Pre-occupancy and final plumbing/heating/electrical before occupancy.
Not a PE stamp. Not an AHJ fail list until a book names one.
typical_duration_sfr: unknown as a separate cycle — Ch2 says schedule inspections to avoid lengthy delays. No lag days invented.
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: Skipping any named inspection. Treating Ch29 maintenance as punch. Inventing IRC final-inspection section numbers. Stamping.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: They call for finals. What they skip is the whole ladder (footings through CO) and that punch is still a Gap.
permit_gate: Certificate of Occupancy is the gate to occupy
permit_gate_notes: Fig 2 CO. Confirm AHJ. Canadian NBC list. No skip-inspection. No stamp.
risk_if_swapped_late: Occupying before CO is not a save.
plain_language_summary: The book’s inspection ladder runs from footings to a certificate of occupancy. Call them in order. Do not skip. Punch-list paperwork is not in this book — that stays a Gap. Maintenance is not punch. This is not a stamp.
